messages:
annika: Hey team — quick post-cutover health loop for client HarborWave (private VPC cutover completed yesterday). I want a short status on networking, IAM, KMS, and audit logs plus any renewal risk / feedback to capture.

mike: Network mostly green. BGP peering stabilized after the second deploy. Seeing one route flapping to the transit gateway (TGW) — tracking it in infra ticket but service-level impact is low.

saira: KMS: HarborWave asked for HSM-backed customer keys (BYOK/HSM). I sent the onboarding doc and asked for the list of key policy approvers. No ETA yet. This is potentially a blocker for compliance and renewal talk.

jorge: IAM work is done from our side — roles and cross-account trust are configured. Waiting on HarborWave to provide their AWS account id and external-id for the observability role.

annika: Audit logs update: they confirmed CloudTrail to central SIEM, but retention is currently 90d; their compliance team wants 365d. I proposed our premium observability retention as an option — could be a renewal conversation.

ops-bot: ticket #CS-4821 created: HarborWave - KMS HSM onboarding (assignee: saira)

mike: Also found an MTU mismatch on the TGW attachment that caused packet fragmentation on large responses. Quick troubleshooting note: check MTU on their edge device and our TGW attachment, standard workaround is to align to 1400 until we can adjust path MTU.

mike: relevant snippet from debug: `tcpdump -i eth0 -s 0 -w capture.pcap` showed RSTs on large packets; switching to 1400 resolved in lab.

saira: For HSM they'll need FIPS attestation and vendor paperwork. Asked for the contract copy and the KMS approval list. If they can't provide approvers by Friday it becomes a renewal risk flag.

annika: Action items:
- mike: resolve route flapping + MTU mitigation by Tue (open a patch ticket to infra if needed)
- saira: escalate HSM requirement & confirm approver list by Fri
- jorge: follow up on external-id with their security lead today
- annika: schedule a 30-min renewal-risk call next Wed and draft notes for AM

mike: ack
saira: ack
jorge: on it

annika: quick poll: do we offer them a 30-day trial extension of 365d audit retention to buy time for HSM/compliance? :thinking_face:

jorge: +1 — should help with churn and gives them breathing room
saira: +1 but must get compliance signoff before enabling
mike: neutral — worry about egress/retention costs, want AM to price it correctly

annika: I'll draft a short SOW and pricing note and loop in AM/legal. Also capturing customer feedback: docs were clear overall but the KMS HSM steps felt manual and unclear. We should add a step-by-step checklist and a short troubleshooting guide to the KB.

annika: tagging @sara-ops for doc backlog visibility

sara-ops: noted, will add HSM onboarding checklist to docs backlog (est 2 sprints). Can you add the exact pain points from the customer?

annika: will capture specifics from the recorded call and post them to the ticket. If we don't get the approver list by Fri escalate to AM. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
